statusText: Mapped policy state: EA_ON. Tail remains low; concentrated macro and Nvidia catalysts keep Stress elevated.
recommendation: Tail remains below the block threshold; the main checkpoints are the 08:30 ET data cluster, the U.S. cash open, and Nvidia's results and conference call.
headline: Low Tail, elevated catalyst Stress
body: Tuesday's technology and semiconductor rebound occurred with lower Treasury yields and oil. Fresh overnight reporting shows only slightly softer U.S. futures, while direct intrahour NQ structure remains limited. Wednesday's macro releases and Nvidia create concentrated event Stress without current evidence of persistent one-way Tail structure.

lookbackSummary: Published Tail stayed low through the preceding 24 clock-hours, with one unavailable historical slot; the most recent finalized assessment was 16% Tail, 59% Stress and normal mode.
outlookSummary: Stress rises sharply into the 12:30 UTC U.S. GDP/PCE/durable-goods cluster and cash open, then again around Nvidia results at about 20:20 UTC and the 21:00 UTC call. Tail remains conditional on persistent one-way price structure, failed retracements and aligned cross-asset confirmation.

forecast.analysis: No major U.S. release is scheduled in this hour. The baseline remains two-way overnight trade; Tail would rise only if directional extension persists while meaningful retracements repeatedly fail.
Early Asia is primarily a price-structure checkpoint. Orderly rotation would keep Tail low, while sustained session-extreme holding with shallow pullbacks would challenge that baseline.
Mid-Asia liquidity can magnify headlines, but a larger move alone would primarily lift Stress. Tail would require directional efficiency plus shallow or failed retracements.
Late-Asia conditions become more sensitive to Europe positioning. Tail remains low unless price holds near an extreme and repeated pullback failures appear.
The Europe transition adds liquidity and cross-asset information. Broader alignment in yields, volatility and semiconductors would matter for Tail only if it reinforces persistent NQ direction.
European cash trading can validate or reject the overnight move. Conflicting cross-assets would favor Stress over Tail; synchronized confirmation with failed pullbacks would raise Tail.
Pre-U.S. positioning becomes more sensitive as the 08:30 ET data cluster approaches. Event importance raises Stress, while Tail still depends on observed directional persistence.
Macro anticipation can widen ranges before the releases. No result is known in advance, so Tail remains conditional on the price structure actually visible into the data.
Dispersion may rise ahead of GDP, Personal Income/PCE and durable goods. A pre-release drift is insufficient for elevated Tail without shallow retracements or repeated extension.

The 08:30 ET data cluster creates the first major event/whipsaw window. Stress is extreme; Tail is WATCH-level only conditionally, pending whether post-release price discovery becomes persistently one-way.

The first post-data hour remains sensitive to second moves in yields and growth/inflation interpretation. Two-way retracement would pull Tail lower; repeated failed retracements would sustain WATCH conditions.
The U.S. cash open overlaps unresolved macro repricing risk. Opening-auction continuation with shallow pullbacks would be the key Tail amplifier; a balanced open would favor Stress over Tail.
After the opening impulse, orderly retracement and cross-asset stabilization would reduce Tail. Continued one-way extension would keep the regime mixed and risk concentrated.
Mid-session risk should ease if the opening move has developed normal retracements. Tail stays low unless price continues to hold near session extremes with repeated extension.
Absent a fresh catalyst, the baseline shifts toward normalized intraday structure. Stress remains elevated but Tail requires renewed directional efficiency rather than volatility alone.
Late-session positioning begins to include Nvidia event risk. The scheduled earnings release is not yet news; its importance raises Stress, not observed Tail.
Approaching the U.S. close, Nvidia sensitivity can lift index dispersion and hedging. Tail remains conditional on whether NQ itself begins showing failed retracements and one-way extension.
Nvidia is expected to release results around 20:20 UTC. No outcome is assumed; Stress is extreme and Tail is WATCH-level only as a conditional event-path risk.

The Nvidia conference call is scheduled for 21:00 UTC. A delayed second leg is plausible only if actual results, guidance and price discovery align; orderly retracement would argue against persistent Tail.
Post-call repricing may remain volatile. Tail stays WATCH-level only if directional extension persists through failed pullbacks; otherwise this is primarily a high-Stress digestion window.
Later evening trade should normalize if Nvidia-driven price discovery becomes two-way. Tail falls back below WATCH under that conditional stabilization path.
Asia handoff risk remains moderate after the U.S. catalyst sequence. Persistent extremes would be the main reason to keep Tail elevated; otherwise mixed conditions dominate.
By the final forecast hour, the baseline assumes event effects have partly decayed. Normal retracements and reduced cross-asset alignment would keep Tail low.
